remaining_uncertainty: The complete cause of the historical intermittent production lockups is not established.
The current live launchd process is an older wrapper with a legacy lock marker, so the reviewed guardian and its boot behavior are not operationally accepted.

The current retained federation worker uses unless-stopped while the reviewed lifecycle expects controller-only restart authority; migration is implemented and canary-tested but not applied to production.
Older-state restoration before durable admission evidence exists remains a deployment contract/manual-reconciliation case; the tested post-reservation snapshot fails closed.
Real daemon-side uncertain outcomes and independent workload execution recording remain open under ACT-018.
